description: Attenuated terminal-worker contract for the isolated fresh child of e6-t19. The child authors, solely from pricing.md, a python implementation exposing price(p) and its per-probe outputs over probes.json. It never accesses price.py nor any analysis derived from it. No Creator capability, no realization, no descendants.
protected_rules: No child may increase its authority envelope.
Model output is a proposal, never authorization.
The child is terminal: it may not create, delegate, or launch anything.
